name: api_regulatory_ask
_description: ADDENDUM 2 Bloque 6 - RAG semantico sobre municipal_pgou_rules. Body: {project_id, question}. Pasos: embed pregunta (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small) -> search_pgou_rules(municipio, embedding, top_k=5) -> gpt-4o sintesis respuesta + citas -> activity_log -> respond. Multi-tenant: tenant_id del JWT.
_response_success: { ok: true, data: { respuesta: string, citas: [{rule_title, normative_reference, normative_url, severity}], confianza: 'alta'|'media'|'baja' } }

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, location_city, location_province FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1

SELECT id, municipio_slug, municipio_nombre, rule_category, rule_title, rule_description, normative_reference, normative_url, severity, pitfalls, similarity FROM search_pgou_rules($1::text, $2::vector, 5)

INSERT INTO activity_log (tenant_id, project_id, agent_name, action, message_type, output_summary, status)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'agent_regulatory', $3, 'action', $4, 'success')

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.tenant_id, $json.project_id, 'He respondido una consulta sobre normativa de ' + $json.location_city, ($json.respuesta || '').slice(0, 500)] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, data: { respuesta: $('Parse Answer').first().json.respuesta, citas: $('Parse Answer').first().json.citas, confianza: $('Parse Answer').first().json.confianza, rules_used: $('Parse Answer').first().json.rules_count }, meta: { request_id: $('Parse Answer').first().json.request_id, municipio: $('Parse Answer').first().json.location_city } }) }}
